title: PlayStation Startup
blurb: Sony launched the original PlayStation in 1994 with a boot sequence that sounds less like a games console and more like a spacecraft coming online. That ethereal swell told a generation the disc had read successfully, and it is impossible to overstate the dread of hearing it stutter or arrive wrong — a bad boot meant a scratched disc, and a scratched disc meant a difficult conversation. It remains one of the most atmospheric startup sequences ever produced, and it introduced a machine that spent most of its life running football games.
origin: The boot sequence from the original PlayStation (Sony, 1994).
